name: Benny
role: Fence at the Ironworks chop shop
about: Fast, friendly, a salesman who's always half-pitching. Plain American.

say: You don't know me, but word travels fast around here you know
And the word is you're new, you're broke, and you can drive.
intro.tone: big warm hello, grinning; rattling off what he knows

male: Listen, nobody in this town is gonna call your cell until they trust you.
Till then, you hear a payphone ringing out on the street, don't walk past it.
female: Listen, nobody in this town is gonna call your cell until they trust you.
Till then, you hear a payphone ringing out on the street, don't walk past it.
intro.tone: breezy brush-off, then leaning in with a tip

say: anything nice you happen to drive off with,
Stop by my shop, and we both do alright.
intro.tone: mock-innocent, then cheerfully honest; signs off warm

say: Well, that didn't go as planned, did it?
Boss man won't be too happy, ehhh...
Just make sure you do better on the next one.
fail.tone: rueful chuckle; shrugging it off, then a friendly nudge

say: Look, you really fucked that one up.
But if you want more work, you better get your shit together.
fail.tone: blunt, then easy-going; a real warning at the end
